request.raw_text: Hi , Please change the center flower type profile into a hexagonal profile for better torque transfer

areas_to_change.action: Replace the flower-shaped profile with a regular hexagonal profile.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The six-lobed flower-type interface surrounding the internally splined center bore.
areas_to_change.location: At the central hub, visible most clearly from the +Z face.
areas_to_change.description: Remove the existing lobed outer boundary of the center interface and create a concentric hexagonal boundary in its place. Retain the existing axial position and interface depth unless required for geometric continuity.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its tooth form, diameter, count, concentricity, axial extent, and orientation.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Rear circular center boss visible from the -Z face
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its circular outer boundary, thickness, and axial location unless the new hexagonal interface must extend through it.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Radial spokes, web, and open cutouts
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their profiles, fillets, arrangement, and connection to the hub and outer rim.
Preserve the tooth count, tooth geometry, pitch diameter, rim details, and concentricity.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Overall part thickness and face contours
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Maintain all existing axial dimensions, offsets, chamfers, and fillets outside the modified center interface.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A concentric hexagonal center interface replaces the current six-lobed flower-shaped interface while the internal spline bore and the remainder of the sprocket remain unchanged.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The hexagonal interface provides six planar torque-reacting faces for engagement with a corresponding hexagonal mating component.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: Torque will be transferred through broad flat contact regions rather than the existing rounded lobes, potentially reducing local contact stress and rotational slip when correctly fitted.

ambiguities.description: The requested hexagon size is not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Fit the hexagon within the minimum envelope of the existing flower profile.
Match the hexagon across-flats dimension to the existing flower profile's nominal functional diameter.
Match the hexagon across-corners dimension to the maximum envelope of the existing flower profile.

ambiguities.description: The angular orientation of the hexagonal profile is not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Place a hexagon flat horizontally in the +Z view.
Place a hexagon vertex on the model's vertical centerline.
Align the hexagon to an existing spoke, spline tooth, or datum axis.

ambiguities.description: The axial extent of the replacement profile is not explicitly stated.
candidate_interpretations: Replace only the flower-shaped recess/interface visible on the +Z face.
Extend the hexagonal profile through the full center-hub thickness.
Use the same axial depth as the existing flower-shaped feature.

ambiguities.description: The phrase 'center flower type profile' could be confused with the toothed internal bore, although the visible six-lobed outer interface is the most likely reference.
candidate_interpretations: Replace only the six-lobed outer interface and preserve the internal spline bore.
Replace the internally splined bore with a hexagonal bore.
Replace both the lobed interface and the internal spline with one hexagonal opening.
